title: Population assumptions & SNI public facilities - reference library
built_from: Published Indonesian regulations / SNI and the HCA Employment Density Guide (2015); every value checked against the cited text

status_legend.verified: Value as stated in the cited standard
status_legend.derived: Value calculated from figures in the cited standard (the note shows how)
status_legend.input: No standard value: enter a project-specific figure

sources.SNI1733: Badan Standardisasi Nasional (2004). SNI 03-1733-2004 Tata Cara Perencanaan Lingkungan Perumahan di Perkotaan. Jakarta: BSN.
sources.PU26: Peraturan Menteri Pekerjaan Umum No. 26/PRT/M/2008 tentang Persyaratan Teknis Sistem Proteksi Kebakaran pada Bangunan Gedung dan Lingkungan, Lampiran Bab III, Tabel 3.10.1.2 Faktor Beban Hunian (m2 per orang, luas kotor kecuali 'bersih'; beban hunian maksimum untuk sarana jalan ke luar).
sources.KEPMEN403: Keputusan Menteri Permukiman dan Prasarana Wilayah No. 403/KPTS/M/2002 tentang Pedoman Teknis Pembangunan Rumah Sederhana Sehat (Rs Sehat), Lampiran I Pedoman Umum, Bab IV dan Tabel 2.
sources.PERMENPERA11: Peraturan Menteri Negara Perumahan Rakyat No. 11/PERMEN/M/2008 tentang Pedoman Keserasian Kawasan Perumahan dan Permukiman, Pasal 8 (perkotaan 101-300 jiwa/ha, maks. 75 unit/ha; pusat kota 301-500 jiwa/ha, maks. 125 unit/ha; pusat metro > 500 jiwa/ha, maks. 300 unit/ha).
sources.HCA2015: Homes & Communities Agency (2015). Employment Density Guide, 3rd Edition. London: HCA. Section 4, Employment Density Matrix (m2 per FTE).

methods.units_lot: Units = Area (m2) x saleable ratio / lot size;  Population = Units x persons per unit
methods.units_gfa: Units = GFA x net efficiency / unit size;  Population = Units x persons per unit
methods.gfa_per_person: Population = GFA / coefficient (m2 GFA per person)
methods.rate_per_gfa: Population = GFA x coefficient (persons per m2 GFA)
methods.rate_per_ha: Population = Area (ha) x coefficient (persons per ha)
methods.hotel: Keys = GFA x net efficiency / room size;  Guests = Keys x occupancy x guests per room;  Staff = Keys x staff per key
methods.fixed: Population = fixed number of persons per parcel

profiles.name: No population
profiles.note: Roads, green, golf, water and other land without occupants.

profiles.name: Landed housing, high density - 400 jiwa/ha
profiles.note: Upper bound of the SNI 03-1733-2004 Tabel 1 'tinggi' class (above it: 'sangat padat', where rumah susun is advised - Tabel 5).

profiles.name: Pusat kota - 500 jiwa/ha
profiles.ref: Pasal 8: pusat kota 301-500 jiwa/ha, maks. 125 unit/ha
profiles.note: Upper bound of the Permenpera 11/2008 Pasal 8 'pusat kota' zone. 'Pusat metro' is > 500 jiwa/ha with no upper value.

profiles.name: Rumah sederhana sehat type 36 - 4 jiwa/unit
profiles.note: Kepmen Kimpraswil 403/KPTS/M/2002 Tabel 2: 9,0 m2 per person -> 36 m2 house for 4 persons (threshold 7,2 m2/person -> 28,8 m2).

profiles.name: Rumah sederhana sehat - 9 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Bab IV.1 and Tabel 2: 9 m2 per orang
profiles.note: Kepmen Kimpraswil 403/KPTS/M/2002 Bab IV.1: kebutuhan ruang per orang 9 m2 (ceiling height 2,80 m); threshold 7,2 m2 per person.

profiles.name: Hunian tidak bertingkat - 10.2 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: section 6: 9,6 m2 per adult, 4,8 m2 per child
profiles.note: SNI 03-1733-2004 section 6: 9,6 m2 main floor per adult and 4,8 m2 per child; a 5-person house totals 51 m2 incl. service area = 10,2 m2 per person.

profiles.name: Dormitory - 18.6 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: Hotel dan Asrama 18,6 m2/orang (gross). Egress maximum.

profiles.name: Apartment building - 18.6 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: Bangunan gedung apartemen 18,6 m2/orang (gross). Egress maximum.

profiles.name: Retail sales area, upper floors - 5.6 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Tabel 3.10.1.2: Perdagangan, di atas lantai jalan 5,6 m2/orang
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2 Perdagangan: daerah penjualan di atas lantai jalan 5,6 m2/orang (two or more street floors: 3,7). Peak egress load - an upper bound for shoppers + staff.

profiles.name: Retail sales area, street floor - 2.8 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2 Perdagangan: daerah penjualan pada lantai jalan 2,8 m2/orang.

profiles.name: Retail employees - 17.5 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Section 4: A1 retail high street 15-20 m2 NIA/FTE
profiles.note: Mid-point of the HCA 2015 range for A1 retail (high street / foodstore 15-20 m2 NIA per FTE). Workers only - no shoppers.

profiles.name: General office - 12 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Section 4: B1a general office 10-13 m2 NIA/FTE
profiles.note: HCA 2015 B1a general office: corporate 13, professional services 12, public sector 12, TMT 11, finance 10 m2 NIA per FTE.

profiles.name: Office (Bisnis) - 9.3 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: Bisnis 9,3 m2/orang (gross). Egress maximum.

profiles.name: Public sector office - 12 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Section 4: B1a public sector 12 m2 NIA/FTE
profiles.note: HCA 2015 B1a public sector office 12 m2 NIA per FTE. Also used for police / fire posts (no headcount standard).

profiles.name: Hotel - 18.6 m2/jiwa
profiles.cf_ref: Section 4: C1 hotels, staff 1 FTE per 5 beds (budget) to 1 per 1 (luxury)
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: Hotel dan Asrama 18,6 m2/orang (gross), guests + staff at full occupancy. Egress maximum.

profiles.name: Assembly, less concentrated - 1.4 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: Pertemuan kurang padat, tanpa kursi tetap 1,4 m2/orang (padat 0,65 bersih). Applies to the hall floor only, not the whole GFA.

profiles.name: Light industrial - 47 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Section 4: B1c light industrial 47 m2 NIA/FTE
profiles.note: HCA 2015 B1c light industrial 47 m2 NIA per FTE.

profiles.name: Industrial & manufacturing - 36 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Section 4: B2 industrial & manufacturing 36 m2 GIA/FTE
profiles.note: HCA 2015 B2 industrial & manufacturing 36 m2 GIA per FTE.

profiles.name: Industri umum - 9.3 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Tabel 3.10.1.2: Industri umum dan berisiko tinggi 9,3 m2/orang
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: Industri umum dan berisiko tinggi 9,3 m2/orang. Egress maximum - well above typical employment density.

profiles.name: Warehouse / logistics - 70 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Section 4: B8 'final mile' distribution 70 m2 GEA/FTE
profiles.note: HCA 2015 B8 'final mile' distribution centre 70 m2 GEA per FTE (regional 77, national 95).

profiles.name: Data centre - 360 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: Mid-point of the HCA 2015 co-location data centre range (180-540 m2 per FTE); wholesale 200-950, dark site 440-1,400.

profiles.name: School / campus classrooms - 1.9 m2/jiwa (net)
profiles.ref: Tabel 3.10.1.2: Pendidikan, ruang kelas 1,9 m2/orang bersih
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: ruang kelas 1,9 m2/orang (net). Apply to classroom floor area only, not the whole GFA.

profiles.name: Rumah sakit - 22.3 m2/jiwa
profiles.ref: Tabel 3.10.1.2: Ruang tindakan rawat inap 22,3 m2/orang
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: ruang tindakan rawat inap 22,3 m2/orang.

profiles.name: Fasilitas kesehatan (rawat inap) - 11.1 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: rawat inap 11,1 m2/orang.

profiles.name: Puskesmas (rawat jalan) - 9.3 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: Permen PU 26/PRT/M/2008 Tabel 3.10.1.2: rawat jalan 9,3 m2/orang.

profiles.name: Tempat ibadah - 1.2 m2/jemaah
profiles.note: SNI 03-1733-2004 section 7.4.3: 1,2 m2 per jemaah incl. prayer, service and circulation. Gives peak congregation capacity, not a daily population.

profiles.name: Taman RT - served residents 1 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: SNI 03-1733-2004 Tabel 16 provision standard (land per SERVED resident). Do not add to residents - it double counts.

profiles.name: Taman kelurahan - served residents 0.3 m2/jiwa
profiles.note: SNI 03-1733-2004 Tabel 16 provision standard (served residents). Double counts residents if summed.

profiles.name: Fixed headcount per parcel
profiles.note: No published standard for this use: enter a known headcount per parcel.

sni_facilities.source: SNI 03-1733-2004 Tabel 6, 8, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 and section 7.9 (transport), checked against the BSN text
